capabilities: Sync card group membership to the note's Status frontmatter property
Record StartedAt, ModifiedAt, and CompletedAt timestamps as cards move
Show an elapsed-days badge on each card from its start time
Archive completed cards manually or on a weekly schedule
Generate a task canvas or a self-contained tutorial canvas from the command palette
disambiguation: Not a full task manager or prioritization tool; it only captures status and timing data by watching card movement on a Canvas.
extras: The card-properties display toggle relies on Obsidian's internal DOM structure and may break after Obsidian updates; bugs and feature requests go through GitHub Issues.
motivation: The author combined what they liked in Notion (logging start/completion dates to review progress) with FigJam's free 2D kanban placement, which lacked any tracking.
problem: Free-form Canvas boards have no task tracking, so cards that started but never finished quietly disappear without any record of when work began or stalled.

relations.evidence: I've relied on both Notion and FigJam for task management over the years.
This plugin combines both. You get a free-form 2D Kanban board on Obsidian Canvas

summary: Kanban board on Obsidian Canvas that syncs card group position to the note's Status frontmatter and records start, modified, and completion timestamps.
